description: This source file contains implementation functions for handling WiFi web configuration, including parsing JSON blobs for SSID and security settings, validating parameters, updating internal WiFi configuration structures, and encoding data back into blobs for control queue processing. It also manages specialized handlers for different WiFi modes (private, home, xfinity, hotspot) and security configurations including WPA3 and Radius settings.
external_methods: heatlth support functions and JSON parsing utilities
